opportunities.title: Visiting research fellowships

amount.raw: up to £1,000 (UK £600, Europe £700, Rest of world £1,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers (academics or curators) working on historic and contemporary sculpture for Visiting Research Fellowships; artists for Artist Research Fellowships; senior scholars for Senior Fellowships. Applicants must be able to use the Institute's research facilities.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowship programme enabling artists and researchers to develop their work by spending a month using Henry Moore Institute facilities in Leeds or Hertfordshire, with accommodation, travel and subsistence expenses provided.
